title: Moderna enjoys stable vaccine sales thanks to global COVID uptake
snippet: While Moderna preps an entry to the oncology market next year with a personalized cancer vaccine, COVID sales are holding steady with several other vaccine launches underway around the world.

title: Forge’s Piteri-Molina on AI, Ohio and what’s next for gene therapy manufacturing
snippet: The BioSpace 40 Under 40 honoree helped steer Forge’s sale to Ajinomoto. Now, Samantha Piteri-Molina sees opportunities in AI-driven analytics and Ohio’s gene therapy ecosystem—with a responsibility to patients worldwide.

title: Agios axes 100-plus R&D roles while awaiting FDA decision
snippet: After the FDA delayed a decision for Agios Pharmaceuticals’ sickle cell disease candidate, the biopharma is letting go of more than 35% of its R&D employees.

title: Sarepta’s new CEO confident in clinical execution as DMD competitors close in
snippet: Sarepta Therapeutics’ newly minted CEO Michael Severino laid out his path to returning the muscular dystrophy therapy maker to the forefront of the rapidly expanding market.

title: Verdicts for Summit/Akeso, Capricor, Vertex mark FDA’s stacked November
snippet: Also lined up are target action dates for Sanofi’s Gaucher disease therapy, GSK’s lung cancer medicine and BridgeBio’s muscular dystrophy drug.

title: Merck, Moderna serve 99% of trial patients with mRNA vaccine as personalized shots near market
snippet: Personalized cancer vaccines are getting closer to market. Merck and Moderna just showed successful manufacturing in a large Phase 3 trial, proving they can deliver the goods.
